title: Testability of thermal leptogenesis
bottleneck: Thermal leptogenesis elegantly generates the baryon asymmetry from CP-violating decays of heavy right-handed neutrinos, but its natural mass scale near 10^9 GeV is forever beyond experimental reach. Low-scale variants exist but sacrifice the minimality and predictive power that made the idea attractive.
why_it_blocks: The leading theoretical explanation of the matter-antimatter asymmetry may be permanently untestable, which would leave cosmology's central particle-physics question answered only in principle.
current_state: Resonant and ARS leptogenesis at the GeV-TeV scale are being probed by beam-dump and collider searches for heavy neutral leptons, offering the only near-term experimental handles. Searches for heavy neutral leptons at beam dumps and colliders probe the GeV-scale variants, though connecting any discovery to the baryon asymmetry would be indirect and model-dependent, leaving the cosmological connection difficult to establish.
